main.description: Get additional details for a stat group. Omit all group selectors for aggregate details.

queueId.description: Queue stat group. Use -1 for unqueued reports; otherwise use a positive queue ID. Requires queue access.

moderatorDid.description: Moderator stat group, based on current report assignment. Requires administrator access.

reportTypes.description: Report-type stat group. Counts only the specified reasons.

startDate.description: First UTC calendar day to include, inclusive. Defaults to today. The range must not exceed 120 calendar days.

endDate.description: Last UTC calendar day to include, inclusive. Defaults to today.

startDate.description: First included UTC calendar day, at midnight.

endDate.description: Last included UTC calendar day, at midnight.

errors.name: QueueNotFound
errors.description: Queue does not exist or is not accessible.

inboundCount.description: Unmuted reports received during the requested UTC calendar days.

reportTypeBreakdown.description: Unmuted inbound reports by actual reason, across all statuses, within the selected stat group and UTC date range.

totalCount.description: Total unmuted inbound reports in this breakdown.
